title: Fincantieri Track 2 requirements supplied in PipeForge Edge 4.0 request
authority: User-supplied challenge transcription; original official documents have not been independently inspected

requirements.description: Minimum surface clearance from pipe and fitting envelopes to structure, equipment and distributed systems
requirements.source_reference: User PipeForge Edge 4.0 specification Phase 3 A

requirements.description: Preferred vertical pipe-center to structure hanger distance; longer allowed but discouraged
Maximum horizontal pipe-edge to structure hanger distance

requirements.method: pipe/fitting lower-envelope height above declared walkway floor

requirements.description: Preferred valve stem elevations above access surface
Bent manufactured pieces sufficiently planar where specified
requirements.method: maximum distance from a plane through piece geometry; tolerance supplied by designer

requirements.description: Minimum bend radius and net straight tangent length between bends
requirements.applicability: nominal pipe sizes explicitly covered; no interpolation
requirements.method: catalog radius and trimmed tangent geometry

requirements.description: Minimum separation from stiffeners and other penetrations
requirements.method: designer must select authoritative units/value with source reference before evaluation
requirements.source_reference: User specification Phase 3 F states inconsistent 2-inch / 50-mm values

requirements.description: Directional offset between relevant deck or bulkhead penetrations
requirements.method: declared relevant penetration pair transverse offset

requirements.description: Minimum segment pitch in explicit ship axes and stated flow direction
requirements.method: segment projections onto explicitly supplied orthogonal ship axes; mixed direction conservative sum of directional falls

requirements.description: Prefer horizontal/vertical routing except functional pitched segments
requirements.method: segment direction relative to explicit coordinate axes

requirements.description: Preserve required connectivity, fixed ports, sizes, permitted bounds and required compartments
requirements.method: compare engineering identifiers and geometry against source network
requirements.source_reference: User specification Phase 3 H and Phase 9
